description: A luminous, grandly-scaled kitchen with an Old World European character expressed through refined classical detailing. The ceiling is high white plaster with a beautifully elaborate egg-and-dart or acanthus-leaf crown moulding at the cornice, its ornamental relief adding a Beaux-Arts quality to what is otherwise a freshly painted bright white space. The back wall features a tall arched display cabinet with glass-paned doors in a Gothic arch form — reminiscent of a library armoire — housing collections of antique plates, copper vessels, and ceramics. The cabinetry throughout is painted soft warm white with glass fronts on some upper sections; open shelving on the right displays a curated arrangement of white ceramic dishware, copper pots, and decorative plates. A professional brass gas range with six burners and a pot filler faucet on the right side anchor the cooking zone in warm gold metalwork. The sink area on the left includes a brushed brass bridge faucet, hanging copper pans on a wall rail, and a small potted green plant sprig at the windowsill. The island holds two matte black ceramic spherical vases of different sizes, wooden utensils, and a small stack of books. The countertops are clean white quartz. Warm glowing light emanates from the two ceiling-hung sources, creating a soft amber-cream warmth over the island surface. Camera is at standing eye-level, wide-establishing composition, framing the full kitchen breadth with the arched cabinet centered in the background.
